title: Flowgit flow test case
description: One case in tests/<name>.json. This is a file convention next to a flow, not part of flow.schema.json. src/flowtest.ts checks it by hand so nothing calls new Function at run time (the web app's Content-Security-Policy forbids that).

name.description: Optional label shown next to the pass or fail mark.

inputs.description: Flow inputs for this case, checked with the same rules as loadFlowInputs, including enum.

replies.description: Directory of canned llm replies (<stageId>.md|txt|json), relative to the flow directory. Defaults to demo-replies/ when omitted.

images.description: Directory of canned pictures in the FLOWGIT_IMAGE_MOCK_DIR layout, relative to the flow directory.

files.description: Maps an output path to a file or directory inside the flow. Copied into place before the run.

skip.description: Stage ids that are not executed. files must supply every output; those outputs are recorded as a manual run.

expect.description: Checks per stage id, run against the temporary copy after the case runs.

file.description: Path relative to the flow directory.

jsonPath.description: Dotted path. A segment named length reads the length of an array or string. No JSONPath library.

equals.description: Compared to the value at jsonPath.
